decisions.reason: As a visible design-line extension that gained its own page in 2024 and fits durable bathroom styling trends, it is likely to remain in the portfolio.
A shower channel for seamless coverings addresses a clear installation trend and has been consistently promoted, so a mature German drainage maker would normally continue it.

Although newer and more niche, it likely serves as the updated pump-drain offering after the earlier pump solution disappeared, so it is more likely to be developed further than withdrawn immediately.
